description: This file defines a benchmark class for testing Orleans transactions with different storage configurations, including memory, Azure, and throttling options. It includes setup, teardown, and execution methods for benchmarking transactional workloads in Orleans test clusters.

classes.name: TransactionBenchmark
classes.description: Contains methods and nested configurator classes for setting up, running, and tearing down Orleans transaction benchmarks across different storage configurations.

classes.name: SiloMemoryStorageConfigurator
classes.description: Configures Orleans silo to use in-memory grain storage for testing.

classes.name: SiloAzureStorageConfigurator
classes.description: Configures Orleans silo to use Azure Table storage with transactional state storage.

classes.name: SiloTransactionThrottlingConfigurator
classes.description: Configures Orleans silo with transaction rate load shedding options enabled.

methods.name: MemorySetup
methods.description: Initializes a test cluster with memory storage configuration.

methods.name: MemoryThrottledSetup
methods.description: Initializes a test cluster with memory storage and throttling configuration.

methods.name: AzureSetup
methods.description: Initializes a test cluster with Azure storage configuration.

methods.name: AzureThrottledSetup
methods.description: Initializes a test cluster with Azure storage and throttling configuration.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Conducts initial and repeated warm runs of the benchmark, printing summarized results.

methods.name: FullRunAsync
methods.description: Launches a run of transactions and aggregates reporting data.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Runs a transactional load asynchronously and retrieves the report.

methods.name: Teardown
methods.description: Stops all silos in the test cluster.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the test cluster resources.
